messages:
Jess: Escalation from ACME — they say a user deprovision event on 2024-09-14 has no corresponding audit line in their tenant export. Customer needs SOC2 evidence; legal looped in. Can security/SRE help check why audit_export missed it? :eyes:

Ethan: Seen the ticket. I pulled the export job logs around that window — we have several 502/503 retries against provisioning API, then an internal 500 when writing audit to object store. Snippet: `2024-09-14T03:12:47Z ERROR audit.export write failed key=tenant-123/user-deprov-456 err=KMS_UNWRAP_FAILED request_id=req_0a1b2c`

Jess: KMS errors would be big for the customer. They claim no manual retention policy changes on their side. They want repro steps + confirmation if data is unrecoverable.

kms-bot: KMS EVENT: unwrap_failure key=acct-keys-prod-1 tid=req_0a1b2c status=denied reason=key_policy_expired :warning:

Rita: I can repro locally with a flow that matches the export job. Steps I used: 1) create tenant with delegated roles 2) deprov user via SCIM (`DELETE /scim/v2/Users/{id}`) 3) trigger tenant audit export (`POST /admin/tenants/{id}/export`) 4) watch worker write to archive bucket. When KMS unwrap fails worker retries then marks record as "pending_cleanup" and export job logs a failure. Example request/response I used: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/admin/tenants/tenant-123/export -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{}'``` logs: `worker-audit-3 | WARN write failed record=deprov-456 attempts=3 err=KMS_UNWRAP_FAILED`

Ethan: Additional notes: the archive lifecycle moved older objects to cold storage after 90 days via archival-runner. The export job writes encrypted blobs; if KMS key policy or HSM wrap state blocks unwrap, the blob isn't transformed into the final audit export line. We're seeing retries that generated billing meter events (multiple requeues -> billing spike) — finance flagged a short-term cost anomaly for that tenant.

Oliver: @jess @ethan we need a compliance timeline for ACME. Action items: 1) Collect KMS request IDs + HSM audit chain for `req_0a1b2c` and surrounding seconds. 2) Check key policy changes/rotation events in the key manager around 2024-09-14. 3) Pull SCIM provisioning traces showing the deprov API call (SCIM request_id) and map to internal audit record id. 4) Decide whether we can surface a signed non-repudiation export (if we can unwrap and rebuild).

Rita: I located more logs: `kms-client | INFO unwrap start req=req_0a1b2c key=acct-keys-prod-1` then `kms-client | ERROR unwrap failed status=403 code=KEY_POLICY_REVOKED` then `archiver | INFO mark pending_cleanup record=deprov-456`. I also see the SCIM trace for the deprov request: `scim-proxy req=scim_9f8e7d user=deprov-456`.

Oliver: If key policy was revoked/changed we need legal to be notified. @lance please queue this for the ACME incident package. Also set retention freeze for that tenant so we don't garbage collect any candidate artifacts while we investigate.

Lance: Will do. Notifying customer that we're investigating; offering interim export of plaintext audit lines if we can reconstruct them. Need ER (estimated remediation) and statement for SOC2. ETA?

Ethan: Short term: I can pull HSM logs and request trace between 03:12:30 - 03:13:15 UTC and hand to Oliver for compliance packaging. Medium term: engineering needs to implement a failover path so archived encrypted blobs with failed unwraps go into a quarantine bucket instead of being dropped after X retries.

Jess: Customer asked for repro steps we used and a signed timeline. I'll attach Rita's repro steps and request the HSM chain from Ethan. Please add the SCIM trace id and audit export job id to the incident packet.

Rita: Repro steps and minimal curl snippets saved to the incident doc. Note: to reproduce you must simulate keypolicy revoke (we used a test key) — do not run on prod keys.

Oliver: A couple of compliance questions: was automatic key rotation scheduled that day? Any emergency rotation/deprovisioning of service accounts for key access? Also confirm whether Dedicated or Private customers have separate KMS integration (ACME is hosted).

Ethan: Rotation job shows `rotation_started=2024-09-14T02:58:00Z rotation_completed=2024-09-14T02:59:02Z` for acct-keys-prod-1 but no subsequent write that revokes access. However there is a policy patch at `2024-09-14T03:11:59Z` that removed a service principal `svc-exporter-1` from access — that's the likely root cause. I'm pulling HSM audit now.

Lance: Customer reply: they need a statement by EOD tomorrow. We also offered a one-time data escrow export (if we can unwrap). Keep updates short — I'll coordinate comms. :lock:

Jess: Thanks team — please post the HSM chain and SCIM request id in this thread once available. Adding `#compliance` tag to the incident doc.

oliver: Copy — will assemble packet when Ethan posts the HSM logs.
